A1.justification: Both PDFs describe IMDPrompter and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices. Corresponding content can be matched despite bibliography expansion and repagination.

before.justification: v2 reports original IMDPrompter detection and localization experiments, component ablations, robustness tests, and supplementary CocoGlide results.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical experiments and appendix results, with revised specificity values in Table 2.

M1.justification: The four-view architecture, OPS, CPC, CFP, PMM, losses, and inference procedure remain unchanged. Equation (4) corrects the written Bayer-view expression; this view and its classifier were already part of v2.

E1.justification: Both versions train on CASIAv2 and evaluate on CASIAv1, COVER, Columbia, IMD2020, and NIST16. CocoGlide generative-editing evaluation already appears in Table 18 of v2 and is retained unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the main and appendix experiments, including the four SAM adaptations in Table 16 and CocoGlide baselines in Table 18. Newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Tables 7 and 9 retain the same dataset counts, metrics, thresholds, preprocessing, model configurations, and training settings. No revised or additional evaluation protocol is reported.

E4.justification: Component, view, SAM, and segmenter ablations are retained, as are hyperparameter sensitivity, prompt-selection proportions, computational comparisons, JPEG/blur robustness, and qualitative examples. Appendix relocation does not introduce additional analyses.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or experimental uncertainty estimates. The reporting practice remains unchanged.

E6.justification: Table 2 revises IMDPrompter specificity from 99.3 to 66.9 on CASIA, 61.3 to 55.2 on COVER, 91.6 to 90.2 on Columbia, and 73.2 to 57.4 on IMD, with corresponding FCN-relative gains updated. This localized correction removes its leading CASIA specificity ranking. Sensitivity, AUC, F1, and other experimental results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equation (4) replaces a duplicated SRM prediction definition with P_Bayer = Phi_Bayer-CLS(f_Bayer), repairing the missing explicit definition of the Bayer-view prediction. The remaining mathematical formulation is unchanged; no theoretical results or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about first applying SAM to manipulation detection, automated prompting, cross-view integration, generalization, and robustness.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and result interpretations remain unchanged, including the specificity discussion in Section 4.1. Section 7.1 retains the limitations concerning wholly generated images and the requirement for complete pixel-level supervision.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hardware, hyperparameters, preprocessing instructions, and baseline reproduction descriptions are retained. No new code or data access information is supplied.

R1.justification: v4 resolves citation placeholders in the introduction, related work, and broader impacts, adding corresponding references such as BioSAM, PQ-SAM, and several language-model and time-series works. Citation coverage expands, but the substantive research positioning and novelty argument remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Editing consists mainly of citation resolution, localized notation corrections, and resulting paragraph reflow. The section order and nearly all explanatory prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 2 and 3 correct CFP output labels from F_SAF to F_CFP. Bibliography expansion shifts appendix pagination and some spacing, while the existing figures and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: The revised Table 2 specificity values restore agreement with the unchanged sensitivity/F1 pairs, while Equation (4) and Figures 2–3 become internally consistent. These are useful, limited corrections. Citation placeholders are resolved, although some replacements are poorly matched, notably citing IMDPrompter itself as an editing tool. Experimental support and substantive limitations remain unchanged.
